reason: Missed calls do cost me jobs, but somebody with a burst pipe doesn't sit there texting a bot, they just ring the next plumber on Google Maps. And I'm not paying almost 1,000 euros up front to two guys with no customers to put something between me and my phone.
objection: Brand new company, nobody's using it, and if it breaks or they're gone in six months my customers get weird messages and I've thrown away the setup money. On top of that I'm not sure an SMS saves an emergency call anyway.
would_change_my_mind: A plumber or heating guy I know saying it brought him real jobs, plus no setup fee or a free month so I can see whether it wins back emergency calls before I pay.
